features.title: Editorial diagram design engine, cloud containment grammar, and agent evaluation suite
acceptance: Declarative specification compiler renders self-contained SVG/HTML for architecture, dataviz (treemap, sankey, slopegraph), and SBGN process diagrams with zero shadows and crisp typography
Containment grammar validator enforces cloud hierarchy rules (VNet, subnet, PaaS private endpoints) and honest-data visual rules
AI/ML evaluation runner measures agent diagram generation accuracy, containment compliance, and latency against labeled benchmarks
OIDC bearer authentication with demo mode and role-based access control enforces endpoint security
Interactive React UI provides diagram editor, live preview, validation inspector, benchmark runner, and artifact export workflows

features.title: Advanced Azure and AWS multi-tier network topology grammar with automatic routing layout
acceptance: Automatic orthogonal routing between sibling VNets and transitive hub-spoke peering connections
Data-attribute validation for NSG flow rules and route tables

features.title: Complete NSG flow rule validation test coverage for access and protocol fields
acceptance: NSG rule validation rejects invalid `access` values (must be Allow or Deny)
NSG rule validation rejects invalid `protocol` values (must be Tcp, Udp, Icmp, or *)
